spec.title: Batch 006 spec: ASR transcription route missing-key preflight parity

slices.title: Missing-key preflight in transcription route
slices.intent: Inline key check at route entry after managed and SSRF blocks, mirroring the TTS precedent. Keyed providers without key return 400 MISSING_API_KEY and never dispatch. S01 also creates the matrix test file with the first two named tests.

symbols.name: POST
symbols.expectation: signature unchanged; body gains the inline key check after managed and SSRF blocks
